# Trish Kopp (D): NYS Assembly, District 7

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Trish Kopp's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://trishkopp.org/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Dawn Marie Kuhn](../kuhn-dawn-marie/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/kopp-patricia> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A first-time candidate's site. The biography matches Branch's profile. The fundraising milestones are campaign press releases, and the district statistics have no sources.

1. The 58%, 50% and 70% affordability statistics are given with no source.
2. The "first and only" public-matching claim was not independently confirmed.
